question: Do control walkthroughs reduce the chance of a material finding on an engagement?

decision_rule.metric: difference in the probability of a material finding, walkthrough minus no walkthrough

column_notes.control_walkthrough: whether the team did a controls walkthrough; typed by hand, so Yes/yes/Y and No/N all appear
column_notes.risk_tier: engagement risk tier set at acceptance, before planning
column_notes.material_finding: whether the engagement ended with a material finding
